statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 18% sits in the low band while Stress 45% is elevated on a stacked event day.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Conditional risk is concentrated in two narrow windows rather than across the whole session: the 06:30Z BOJ press conference and the 13:30Z US cash open on quadruple-witching expiry. Outside those windows the observed overnight structure remains two-way and Tail stays below the block threshold.
headline: NQ consolidates near 29,770 after an orderly BOJ hike; Ueda presser and quad-witching expiry frame the day's risk windows
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73%, in a broad post-Fed relief rally led by semiconductors, with the 2-year at 4.673% and the 10-year at 4.934% after declines of 5.4bp and 7.0bp, and VIX down 12.8% to 15.44. The Bank of Japan then raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25% on a 7-2 vote in the Asian session, the highest since 1995. NQ futures absorbed that print without one-way continuation: the contract trades near 29,767, about +0.1%, inside a narrow 29,648-29,773 overnight range having recovered off the low, so meaningful retracement is intact. Crude is easing for a third session near $101.3 WTI as Middle East supply concerns recede, which removes one potential amplifier. Tail is therefore held at 18% in the low band. Stress is elevated at 45% because two independent catalysts remain ahead: Governor Ueda's 06:30Z press conference, which is the delayed second leg of the BOJ hike and the main yen-carry transmission channel, and the 13:30Z US cash open, where Fed Bowman and the expiry-day special opening rotation land on the same instant into an already aligned bullish regime. Roughly $6.2tn of US options exposure expires at the 20:00Z settlement. CME index futures then halt for the weekend from 21:00Z, which removes any live price path and lowers both conditional Tail and Confidence across the final seven forecast hours.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 17-26% and Stress decayed from 67% to 41% as the post-FOMC relief rally matured. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday, at the US cash open, when trend-up structure was most pronounced. Tail fell back through the afternoon as retracements reappeared, and the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound mode with Tail 17-18% and Confidence steady near 87%.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry two narrow conditional-risk peaks. Tail rises into the watch band around the 06:30Z BOJ press conference, peaking at 24% at 07:00Z on yen-carry transmission risk, then eases through the European morning. The single hour mapped to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES is 13:00Z, where the US cash open, Fed Bowman and the expiry-day opening rotation coincide into an aligned bullish regime; Tail is 25% there and falls back if the opening auction shows normal-depth retracement. A secondary Stress peak accompanies the 20:00Z quadruple-witching settlement. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 13-15% and Confidence eases into the solid band.
